Common questions

How much does a website cost?+

Starter and Business have indicative starting prices. We quote custom work after agreeing the scope.

How long does a website take?+

Starter: about 2–3 weeks. Business: about 4–6 weeks. Custom platforms are scheduled after discovery.

Can I edit the site myself?+

We can include a content editor for the parts of the site you need to update, such as menus, products, or event details.

Can we work together remotely?+

Yes. We work from India using calls, shared previews, and written feedback. We agree working hours and review times at the start.
